tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Bidder shall ensure credit of Tender processing fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank account of e-procurement on or before the date of bid submission.

The tenderer is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments will not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches.
EMD Payments through e Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection
Past track record of the bidder in KSPCB will be considered for evaluation. If the performance of the bidder in respect of works awarded earlier is not satisfactory such bidders will be disqualified.
For any clarification please contact the office of Building Section, K.S.P.C.B or contact Ph: 25581383 25589112.
The Department KSPCB reserves the right to accept or cancel all the tenders at any time without assigning any reason.
One percentage of the bill amount will be deducted towards construction workers welfare fund from the bill.
Other terms and conditions as per tender document.
The quoted Rates shall be of excluding GST and GST will be paid to the quoted price.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Each and every page of the tender documents submitted/uploaded in e-procurement portal shall be signed by the authorized signatory of the concerned tenderer.
Photographs of projects that have been implemented shall be uploaded.
PMC shall have following technical staff on its establishment or as associated staff with the firm. 1.Architectural Engineers 2.Soil Mechanics Engineers 3.Public Health Engineers

The applicant should have good track record and should not have been black listed /banned for participation in tenders issued by any entity, government / semi-government organization in India/other countries as on date of submission of EOI.

The Average annual turnover of the company should be Rs.25.00 Lakhs or more for 2 years during the last 5 financial years i.e. 2020-21 to 2025-2026. Furnish copy of the Annual Report or Balance sheet, Profit & loss Account and schedules in support of turnover. The tenderer shall submit the copy of Income Tax Return filed with the Income Tax Authorities for the last 5 Financial Years viz., 2020-21 to 2025-2026.

The consultant shall have resource persons in their office in each of the discipline of process, and experience of having successfully assisted the customer to prepare request for proposal, its evaluation and order placement as well as implement contracts for Preparation of DPR,TOR,Design,Engineering,Estimates and CONSULTANT at least one project in Central or State Government organizations MNC of minimum worth Rupees. 2.50 Crores sanctioned cost. Curriculum Vitae of -refer eligibility criteria.

The consultant should have Carried out Consultancy service and including CONSULTANT for buildings for at least one project during last three 3 years. Documentary proof Work done/ completion certificate in the form of client certificate shall be submitted along with the bid. The tenderer should submit the proof of same nature of work Work done/ completion certificate valued Rs.2.50 Crore or more at least in any one of the last 5 financial years i.e., 2020-21 to 2025-2026.

The consultant should have worked in similar or any other projects. Documentary proof of having rendered Consultancy services and CONSULTANT at least one project in Central or State Government organizations/MNC for such organizations shall be produced along with the bid. For preparation of Plans, Design, Drawings related to Civil, Electrical, Water supply and Plumbing works and CONSULTANT etc.

The Project Management Consultant firm shall compulsorily have following technical personnel in its establishment. 1.Structural Engineers 2.Senior Civil Engineers 3.Electrical Engineers 4.Field Engineer civil PMC who do not have the above technical persons in its establishment need not apply and such tender will be rejected.

The tenderer should be a either Proprietorship or Partnership Firm or Private Limited Company or Public Limited Company/ firm having its registered in Council of Architect India. Furnish the copy of certificate Incorporation or partnership deed or Registration copy with the appropriate authorities in support of the name of organization.
The tenderer should produce the copy of Permanent Account Number PAN and GST issued by the Income Tax Authorities.
